description.narrative: Project will identify, incubate, and bring to market readiness transformative projects that help leverage co-financing from, but not limited to, venture capitalists, pension funds, philanthropies, bilateral partners and even domestic fiscal financing. The project will seek to unlock domestic liquidity/capital using development finance as de-risking capital to create a strong business case for attracting foreign investments in the green and blue economy space. This Project plans to support investment readiness of up to 17 MSME businesses over a 18- 24 months period. A combination of preparatory grant support and investment de-risking using sister UN agencies or suitable national implementing partners to unlock domestic liquidity will be used. The project will also focus on creating an enabling environment for MSME financing and holistic development by strengthening national policies for the development of dedicated innovation zones/hubs for MSME incubation and growth. It will also work with national Government
